title: Difference in event_shape between pyro's LKJCholesky and torch's
author: tingiskhan

comments.author: ordabayevy
comments.body: It looks like `pyro.distributions.transforms.cholesky.CorrLCholeskyTransform` should be deprecated in favor of `torch.distributions.transforms.CorrCholeskyTransform`. Is that true @fritzo @fehiepsi?

comments.author: fehiepsi
comments.body: Yes, I think we can use the upstream one.
